newsitem.title: USA: Mellon completes financing unit purchase.
newsitem.headline: Mellon completes financing unit purchase.

text.p: Mellon Bank Corp said on Monday it completed its previously announced $1.7 billion acquisition of the Business Equipment Financing unit of US Capital Corp.
US Capital is a subsidiary of Ford Motor Corp.

The Business Equipement Financing unit has a portfolio of about $1.5 billion and is a leading middle market leasing and financing provider for business equipment to over 2,500 middle market companies, Mellon said in a statement.
Mellon said it would soon complete its previously announced acquisition of First United Leasing Corp.
